CustomField.description: Set by the Chase Pending Check Orders flow when it files the follow-up task, and read by that same flow to decide whether to file one. It is what makes the chase happen once rather than every night: the flow cannot ask "have I already done this" any other way, and a task closed by somebody who did not get the check would otherwise be replaced by a new one the next morning. Untick it by hand to have the flow chase again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked once the office has been asked to chase this check. Untick to have the nightly flow ask again.
CustomField.label: Check Chase Task Created
